parameters.name: index_name
parameters.description: The name of the index to be created.

parameters.name: index_body

parameters.name: opensearch_conn_id
parameters.description: opensearch connection to use

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A Dictionary OpenSearch DSL query.

parameters.name: search_object
parameters.description: A Search object from opensearch-dsl.

parameters.name: index_name
parameters.description: The name of the index to search for documents.

parameters.name: opensearch_conn_id
parameters.description: opensearch connection to use

parameters.name: opensearch_conn_class
parameters.description: opensearch connection class to use

parameters.name: log_query
parameters.description: Whether to log the query used. Defaults to True and logs query used.

parameters.name: open_search_conn_id
parameters.description: Connection to use with OpenSearch

parameters.name: log_query
parameters.description: Whether to log the query used for OpenSearch

parameters.name: base_log_folder
parameters.description: Base folder to store logs locally.

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description: max bytes size for the log file

parameters.name: backup_count
parameters.description: backup file count for the log file

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: default False -> StreamHandler, True -> Handler

parameters.name: end_of_log_mark
parameters.description: A marker string to signify the end of logs.

parameters.name: write_stdout
parameters.description: Whether to also write logs to stdout.

parameters.name: json_format
parameters.description: Whether to format logs as JSON.

parameters.name: json_fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the JSON log output.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: OpenSearch host name.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: OpenSearch port.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username for OpenSearch authentication.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for OpenSearch authentication.

parameters.name: write_to_opensearch
parameters.description: Whether to write logs directly to OpenSearch.

parameters.name: target_index
parameters.description: Name of the index to write to when direct OpenSearch writes are enabled.

parameters.name: host_field
parameters.description: The field name for the host in the logs (default is "host").

parameters.name: offset_field
parameters.description: The field name for the log offset (default is "offset").

parameters.name: index_patterns
parameters.description: Index pattern or template for storing logs.

parameters.name: index_patterns_callable
parameters.description: Callable that dynamically generates index patterns based on context.

parameters.name: os_kwargs
parameters.description: Additional OpenSearch client options. This can be set to "default_os_kwargs" to load the default configuration from Airflow's settings.
